attempts.source: HuggingFace dataset ironflow/hyperliquid-candles-1h (CC BY 4.0, node-derived Hyperliquid-native perps; publisher compares hour-by-hour with Hyperliquid candleSnapshot)
commands: PYTHONPATH=. /tmp/crs-venv/bin/python -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; print([d.id for d in HfApi().list_datasets(author='ironflow')])"
attempts.evidence: Dataset is the same Ironflow candles-1h source already ingested as C14 wide archive (hyperliquid_ironflow_wide_20261115T214900Z, 197 perps, 6792-bar spec window). Its earliest bar is 2025-05-25T14:00:00Z, so it cannot supply pre-2025-05-25 history and cannot reach the >=2023-01-01 multiyear target. No other ironflow candle datasets exist.
Public API serves a moving tail only (earliest 2026-04-21T15:00:00Z, 3849/6792 bars max); cannot supply 283d spec prefix nor multiyear history.

existing_verified_native_archives.note: Widest available verified Hyperliquid-native archive used by C14 (113 symbols @ $5M gate).

conclusion.reason: No verified Hyperliquid-native hourly OHLCV source covering >=2023-01-01 is reachable: public API is retention-limited (moving tail from ~2026-04-21) and the only identified native Ironflow candles dataset begins 2025-05-25T14:00:00Z. C14 already exhausted the widest available native window (283d spec, 197-file archive, 113 selected @ $5M).

provenance_caveat: Acquisition-attempt evidence only; no new market data fabricated. Cross-venue OKX/Binance archives present in repo remain is_hyperliquid_venue_data=false and are not relabeled.
